about: Cabinet „Solicitările mele” row (2026-10-20: the act row of js/act-row.js with the request's content) vs the „Actele mele permisive” act row. a = pp-01 (act „Cafeneaua „Izvoraș”” — Valabil, green Small tag), b = sm-01 (request „Cantina „Nord”” — Finalizat, green Small tag; same tone so tag colours compare). Card box, title, tag, meta and a meta part must have 0 differences. Phones (action-menu-v1, 2026-10-20): ONE anatomy for both — row 1 = [icon ·] tags · the action button right (acts „Postprocese ⌄”, library btn-neutral btn-sm, in the flow — under the meta when it does not fit), title 16/24 at every width, row 2 = title 16/24, row 3 = meta; the action button is a compared pair for height / radius / font / border only. row-kebab-v1 (2026-10-20, user „back to 3 dots, Acțiuni is too ambiguous” + „the 3 dots absolutely positioned on mobile”): the request trigger is ON PURPOSE a different library button — the icon-only ⋮ `btn btn-strict btn-sm btn-icon-only` (32 square, r6, no fill, no padding) — so its fill / padding / gap / flex props are ignored; on phones it sits in the card's top-right corner (top = right = 10 inside the border, centre = the 20 tag line), the row reserves 40 on the right for row 1 and gives it back to title / meta / notice (`expected` at 375 / 320). Run: node --experimental-websocket --no-warnings tools/ui-qa/compare-styles.mjs --a pp-01 --b sm-01 --spec tools/ui-qa/specs/cabinet-request-row-vs-act-row.json --viewports 1440,375,320 Ignored (content, not style): the action column width (grid-template-columns) and the right edges of title / meta (text length). Request rows have NO lead icon (user 2026-10-20), so the text starts at the card padding: title / meta rect.x are ignored (12 vs 48) and the icon pair is gone. Notice = the act row's locked notice (Laborator, warning) vs the request „Informații suplimentare” alert (warning).
